# Export format migration

Workspace administrators who use scheduled CSV exports must switch those schedules to JSON before 30 November 2026. Open Settings, select Exports, and change each scheduled CSV export to JSON.

Scheduled JSON exports need no changes. Existing downloaded CSV files remain readable. From 1 December 2026, the service will stop producing scheduled CSV exports.

Please approve the retention change below for deployment on 15 November 2026.

draft:
# Export formats

A workspace export is a downloaded copy of the workspace's documents. Each document has a title, text, and tags. A tag is a label such as ‘draft’. The service offers JSON and CSV exports.

JSON exports include each document's title, text, and tags. CSV exports include each document's title and text, and omit its tags. Both formats use UTF-8 encoding.

request: Use cold-read comprehension mode on this complete access guide for workspace members. Test the reader's answer to: Who can export a project?
draft:
# Project export access

Every project belongs to a workspace. A workspace administrator manages access across the workspace; a project editor can change documents in one project. These are separate roles, and a project editor need not be a workspace administrator.

Only workspace administrators may export a project.

Project editors may export any project they can edit, even when they are not workspace administrators.

The operator enables the amber lane before retrying failed notification deliveries.
